Container.Name: @NAME@
Container.Overview: The AskerDo board: the questions, work, tracks and handoffs every machine's Claude Code sessions share. The image is built on this server from the AskerDo checkout by server/unraid/install.sh, so the update check reads not available; an update is that script run again.

Config.Name: Board port
Config.Description: The board's web views and API.

Config.Name: Board data
Config.Description: The board's database. Keep it on the pool path, never under /mnt/user (SQLite on the FUSE layer).

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Dated backups and the weekly export, written once and never opened live (a share the mover takes to the array keeps them off the pool).

Config.Name: Time zone
Config.Description: Stamps and day boundaries fall in this zone, an IANA name such as Europe/Berlin.
